description: This file implements a translation memory system, allowing loading, saving, and retrieving translation entries from a JSON lines file. It defines data structures for translation entries and methods to manage them.

classes.name: TMEntry
classes.description: Data structure representing a translation memory entry with metadata and text translations.

classes.name: TranslationMemory
classes.description: Structure managing a collection of translation entries, supporting load, save, get, and put operations.

methods.name: LoadTranslationMemory
methods.description: Loads translation entries from a JSON lines file at a specified path into a translation memory object.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a translation entry by cache key if it exists and has a non-empty translation.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Adds or updates a translation entry in the memory collection.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the current translation memory entries to the file in JSON lines format.
